# CLI reference

Exit codes: `0` OK · `1` a gate failed (`--strict`, `quarantine check`, `replay --min-accuracy`) · `2` invalid configuration · `3` internal error (only with `AICD_FAIL_ON_INTERNAL_ERROR=true`). Logs go to stderr; stdout carries command output.

## `aicd analyze`

end of every pipeline: triage failures, track flaky tests, triage security alerts

```text
Usage: aicd analyze [options]

end of every pipeline: triage failures, track flaky tests, triage security
alerts

Options:
  -c, --config <file>  configuration file (default: .aicd.yaml)
  --set <key=value>    override a configuration key, repeatable (e.g.
                       agents.triage.autonomy=act)
  --ci <name>          CI adapter (auto-detected by default) (default: "auto")
  -v, --verbose        debug logs
  -q, --quiet          warnings and errors only
  --json               machine-readable output on stdout
  --dry-run            decide everything, execute nothing
  --log <file>         local adapter: log file of a failed job, repeatable
  --junit <glob>       JUnit reports, repeatable (default: inputs.junit)
  --sarif <glob>       SARIF reports, repeatable (default: inputs.sarif)
  --diff <file>        local adapter: diff file
  --state <path>       SQLite state file (default: state.path)
  --strict             exit 1 when an agent reports a failing status
  -h, --help           display help for command
```

## `aicd tests select`

print the tests the change needs (empty output = run the whole suite)

```text
Usage: aicd tests select [options]

print the tests the change needs (empty output = run the whole suite)

Options:
  -c, --config <file>  configuration file (default: .aicd.yaml)
  --set <key=value>    override a configuration key, repeatable (e.g.
                       agents.triage.autonomy=act)
  --ci <name>          CI adapter (auto-detected by default) (default: "auto")
  -v, --verbose        debug logs
  -q, --quiet          warnings and errors only
  --json               machine-readable output on stdout
  --dry-run            decide everything, execute nothing
  --format <format>    output format (choices: "lines", "args", "json", default:
                       "lines")

  -h, --help           display help for command
```

## `aicd deploy record`

record a deployment (start and end of the deploy job) for DORA, the guardian and post-mortems

```text
Usage: aicd deploy record [options]

record a deployment (start and end of the deploy job) for DORA, the guardian and
post-mortems

Options:
  -c, --config <file>          configuration file (default: .aicd.yaml)
  --set <key=value>            override a configuration key, repeatable (e.g.
                               agents.triage.autonomy=act)
  --ci <name>                  CI adapter (auto-detected by default) (default:
                               "auto")
  -v, --verbose                debug logs
  -q, --quiet                  warnings and errors only
  --json                       machine-readable output on stdout
  --env <environment>
  --status <state>             (choices: "in_progress", "success", "failed",
                               "paused", "rolled_back", "unknown")
  --id <id>                    deployment id (default: <env>-<sha>)
  --sha <sha>                  deployed commit (default: the pipeline's)
  --service <name>
  --release-version <version>  version of the deployed service
  --url <url>
  --started-at <iso>
  --rollback-of <id>           this deployment rolls back another one
  -h, --help                   display help for command
```

## `aicd replay`

shadow mode: run the agents on labelled past failures and score them, publish nothing

```text
Usage: aicd replay [options]

shadow mode: run the agents on labelled past failures and score them, publish
nothing

Options:
  -c, --config <file>     configuration file (default: .aicd.yaml)
  --set <key=value>       override a configuration key, repeatable (e.g.
                          agents.triage.autonomy=act)
  --ci <name>             CI adapter (auto-detected by default) (default:
                          "auto")
  -v, --verbose           debug logs
  -q, --quiet             warnings and errors only
  --json                  machine-readable output on stdout
  --fixtures <dir>        directory of replay cases
  --min-accuracy <ratio>  exit 1 below this accuracy (0 to 1)
  --llm-only              skip rules and history: evaluate the LLM alone
  -h, --help              display help for command
```
